$comment: Pinned benchmark inputs for reproducible Swain eval jobs. Framework versions, the Swain release, and the model/variant are separate lock dimensions and must appear in every job's resolved configuration. Never silently update any pin in an existing baseline.

resolved.$comment: Populated on the first live resolve by Harbor 0.20.0 (harbor sync / job start). Once recorded, a run whose resolved digests differ must fail rather than proceed on a drifted dataset.

swain_release.$comment: Set via SWAIN_EVAL_VERSION at run time. The exact release version and the per-archive SHA-256 read from the release checksums.txt are the artifact lock dimension; the install shell verifies them before extraction.
